thread:
nina: Heads-up — Cobalt asked for a short POC runbook: which catalog models we'll propose, a tight timeline, security checklist, and a back-of-envelope cost range. Need by EOD tomorrow.

cb_contact: Use case = live support summarization + intent tagging. Expected traffic ~9-12 rps, typical convo ~1600-2200 tokens. Target P95 latency <=220ms. Data contains PII (emails/order ids). Prefer open models; quant variants ok. Hosted for pilot is fine.

omar: Quick clarifier — do they require KMS from day 1 or only if they move to prod?

cb_contact: KMS from day 1 preferred. SOC2 required for production review. Incident SLA: 4hr initial response would be ideal.

sylvie: KMS + SOC2 noted. I'll assemble a one-pager: SOC2 attestation, KMS options (AWS/GCP envelope), access logs + retention, redaction guidance. Any residency constraints?

paul: Infra note: hitting P95 <=220ms at 12rps with ~2k tokens leans hard on low batching for the low-latency path. Two-variant approach looks right: a fp16 13B for low-latency hosted route and a quant 13B for cost/throughput (dedicated burst). KV cache will help for repeated context.

omar: Rough pilot routing sketch (informal):
```
routes:
  - low_latency:
      model: open-13b-fp16
      batch_size: 3
      max_seq: 2048
  - econ_throughput:
      model: open-13b-quant-4bit
      batch_size: 28
      kv_cache: true
fallback: prefer_low_latency_then_quant
estimate_note: "~$2.9/token-unit fp16; ~$0.8/token-unit quant (very rough)"
```

dan: Legal: I'll draft a KMS addendum + DPA template. Need a simple dataflow diagram and subprocessors list from sales.

nina: Good. Sales needs a one-page ops playbook with owners. Omar — can you draft that + a 3-tier pricing sketch (trial, monthly reserve, 12mo commit) and rough timeline?

omar: On it. Timeline idea: 1) Discovery & security kickoff (2 business days), 2) Pilot setup & traffic replay (5 business days), 3) Pilot run (2 weeks), 4) Handoff/contract (1 week). Will include commit tiers and breakeven.

sylvie: For the security packet I'll include short answers to likely questionnaire items (data retention, access controls, key management, audit logs). Will note that envelope KMS requires customer key creation + access tests (1-3 days to validate).

paul: Ops blockers to call out: KMS tech onboarding + paperwork (1-2 weeks), VPC/private path adds network work (2-3 weeks), low-latency target forces lower batching (higher cost).

cb_contact: This is helpful. Any expected customer work up-front?

omar: Minimal for hosted: create KMS key (if using customer-managed), provide test credentials, and a small sample dataset for redaction checks. For dedicated/VPC later: peering, firewall rules, KMS access tests. We'll send a checklist.

nina: Action items for EOD tomorrow:
- omar: one-page ops playbook + pricing triad + pilot timeline
- sylvie: security one-pager + questionnaire answers
- dan: KMS addendum draft + DPA template
- paul: infra note on latency tradeoffs + onboarding checklist
- nina: assemble and send to Cobalt

cb_contact: Thanks all — we'll review and can hop on a 30m sync after doc share.

nina: I'll schedule a 30m once we upload. Thanks team :pray:
